decisions.reason: VueTOC was publicly announced on the home page as a new approach to mobile map control and builds on the established offer, so management keeps it, though as a small component it could be folded into the platform and its visibility after 2018 is unclear.
The GIS platform is the firm's flagship product line, central to its announced direction and heavily invested in, so dropping it would contradict the firm's public strategy.
The search extension has its own page and is tied to the firm's web map app ecosystem, so having already pruned weaker plugins, management keeps it as part of the committed platform.
